rationale: Comment-only change to repaint_damage.cpp's is_sampling_hazard, recording why the new backdrop-filter chain needs no case of its own: its blur is the only spatial part and is already stored as backdrop_blur, which the function tests above, and its remaining colour operations are point-wise on pixels already inside the damage rect. No behaviour changes and no code path is added or removed; the note exists so the next reader does not add a redundant hazard case when they see backdrop_filter_chain appear on View. Pulp-only: the accompanying backdrop-filter work originates here, with no counterpart framework change to backport.
